# Project2DFX upstream attribution

The VCS LOD-light dataset and behavior reference used by this profile come from the MIT-licensed GTA VCS Project2DFX sources in ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack.

Pinned reference commit: `37057d3883bd607ae047c9f031fe083c32b21c88`.

The original MIT copyright and permission notice are preserved in `LICENSE.txt`. The native integration in this repository is a separate host-side implementation and does not load the original PSP plugin.
